name: Japan in Britain
blurb: Japan-related business in the UK across three strands: food and drink, travel, and culture. Each strand is taught as a sector (who buys, who sells, the route to the customer, the rules, what is changing), with history first.
framework: Standard sector analysis plus the categories used in JNTO, JETRO and VisitBritain market reports.

syllabus.title: Japan in Britain: the shape of the market
syllabus.goal: Describe the three strands and their rough size in two minutes

syllabus.title: 1862 to 1910: Japonisme and the great exhibitions
syllabus.goal: Explain how Victorian Britain first bought into Japan

syllabus.title: 1970s to 1990s: the corporate community and its shops
syllabus.goal: Describe the expatriate market that Japanese firms' arrival created

syllabus.title: 1992 onwards: from noodle bar to mainstream
syllabus.goal: Explain how British founders took Japanese food to the high street

syllabus.title: The restaurant landscape
syllabus.goal: Sort the market into chains, independents and high-end

syllabus.title: Who owns what
syllabus.goal: Tell British-founded brands from Japanese-owned ones, and why it matters

syllabus.title: Sushi in the supermarket
syllabus.goal: Explain the grab-and-go trade and who supplies it

syllabus.title: How dishes get adapted
syllabus.goal: Trace ramen, katsu curry and matcha from import to British staple

syllabus.title: Sake, whisky and tea
syllabus.goal: Describe how Japanese drinks are sold in the UK

syllabus.title: The supply chain
syllabus.goal: Map importers, wholesalers and specialist grocers

syllabus.title: Britons to Japan
syllabus.goal: Say who goes, when, where and what they spend

syllabus.title: The travel trade
syllabus.goal: Compare specialist tour operators, generalists and independent booking

syllabus.title: Japan's side of the trade
syllabus.goal: Explain what Japan's tourism bodies want from the UK market

syllabus.title: The reverse flow
syllabus.goal: Describe Japanese visitors and residents in the UK and what they buy

syllabus.title: Anime, manga and games
syllabus.goal: Describe the fan market and who sells to it

syllabus.title: Events and institutions
syllabus.goal: Compare commercial festivals with government-backed venues

syllabus.title: Design, fashion and homeware
syllabus.goal: Explain how Japanese retail brands position themselves in Britain

syllabus.title: Learning Japan
syllabus.goal: Describe the market for language, crafts, martial arts and wellness

syllabus.title: The rules
syllabus.goal: Explain import rules for food and alcohol, work visas and the trade agreement

syllabus.title: Japanese companies entering the UK
syllabus.goal: Compare entries that worked with ones that failed

syllabus.title: What is changing
syllabus.goal: Identify the trends that will matter over five years

syllabus.title: Where the gaps are
syllabus.goal: Weigh the main ways to act on what you have learned
